stem_book: A cyclic process ABCD is shown in P–V diagram for an ideal gas (A→B isobaric expansion, B→C isothermal expansion, C→D isochoric pressure drop, D→A isothermal compression). Which of the following diagrams (V–T plots, see figure) represents the same process? (a) (b) (c) (d)
reason: Options are drawings; figure (with the four V–T option graphs) required. Curve types stated explicitly.
work: V–T: A→B straight line through origin (V ∝ T), B→C vertical up at T_B, C→D horizontal left (V const, T falls), D→A vertical down at T_A ⇒ option (c)
